info.title: Beggy API
info.description: Beggy is an AI-powered smart travel packing assistant API.

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Authentication & identity management including login, registration, and session handling

tags.name: Users
tags.description: User account management including retrieval, updates, and administrative operations

tags.name: Profiles
tags.description: User profile management including personal details and onboarding state

tags.name: Bags
tags.description: Bag management including creation, organization, and capacity tracking

tags.name: Containers
tags.description: Container state management including packing, unpacking, item movement, and constraint evaluation (weight, capacity, status)

tags.name: Items
tags.description: Item management including CRUD operations, categorization, and inventory tracking

tags.name: Dashboard
tags.description: Aggregated dashboard overview combining profile state, item insights, and recent activity

post.description: Registers a new user using email and password credentials.
Authenticates a user using email and password and issues authentication cookies.

delete.description: Invalidates the current authenticated session and clears authentication cookies.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of bags belonging to the authenticated user with filtering, ordering, and pagination support.

post.description: Creates a new bag along with its backing container.

get.description: Returns a single bag owned by the authenticated user.

patch.description: Partially updates a user-owned bag and its container constraints.

delete.description: Deletes a user-owned bag and its backing container.

get.description: Retrieves a typed container (Bag or Suitcase) with its full domain representation.
Retrieves the full container state including metrics and constraint status.

post.description: Adds or increments an item inside a container and returns updated container summary.
Removes or decreases quantity of an item from a container and returns updated summary.
Moves an item from one container to another and returns both updated container summaries.

get.description:
Returns the full aggregated dashboard overview for the authenticated user.

This endpoint composes multiple domain datasets into a single optimized payload:
- Profile onboarding state
- Item statistics (total & fragile counts)
- Recent items (latest 5)
- Item category distribution

Designed for dashboard initial load to avoid multiple API calls.
Returns a paginated list of items owned by the authenticated user. Supports filtering, ordering, and pagination.

post.description: Creates a new reusable item owned by the authenticated user.

get.description: Returns a single item owned by the authenticated user.

patch.description: Applies partial updates to a user-owned item.

delete.description: Deletes a user-owned item by ID.

get.description: Returns the private profile of the currently authenticated user.

patch.description: Partially updates the profile of the authenticated user. Supports PATCH semantics where only provided fields are updated.

get.description: Returns the public-facing profile of a user by profile ID. This endpoint exposes only whitelisted public fields.

get.summary: Retrieve a paginated list of users
get.description: Returns a paginated list of user accounts with optional filtering, searching, and ordering. Intended for administrative use.

post.description: Creates a new user account. Intended for administrative provisioning workflows.

delete.description: Deletes multiple users based on optional filtering criteria. Intended for administrative cleanup and moderation workflows.

get.description: Returns a single user account by its unique identifier.

delete.description: Deletes a single user account using its unique identifier.

patch.description: Partially updates profile-related information for a specific user. Does not affect authentication, role, or account status.
Updates moderation-related status flags such as activation state and email verification status.
Updates the role assigned to a specific user. Restricted to authorized administrators.
